(above: sha256 of /Users/ember/dev/verekos/slice1/mapper.py at copy time.)
mapper.py is W17's file, copied unchanged so the reader folder runs on its own. The reader uses
it for three things only: `num` (the atom id of a statement from its structural key), `split` /
`structural_key` (the statement boundaries), and `Doc` / `Source` (reading a signed read).
Compare with `sha256sum slice1/mapper.py` to see whether W17's file has moved on.
